premises.text: Community organizers and members currently juggle multiple separate platforms for events, email, member management, and engagement
premises.evidence_span: I've had to use five platforms to stay organized

premises.text: Cohort is a single umbrella for communication, event, member, and transaction management with group pages and discussion-board-integrated email lists
premises.evidence_span: Communication management, event management, member management, transaction management, under one umbrella

premises.text: Member directory, profiles, and custom application forms enable targeted communication and events to membership subsets
premises.evidence_span: We also have a complete member management system. It's a full membership directory

premises.text: Advanced ticketing and dues tiers with transaction handling so organizers never touch cash
Hierarchical subgroups/chapters get full toolsets with autonomous local leadership plus global communications/events
premises.evidence_span: Each group can have as many subgroups as they want and as many tiers of subgroups as they need

premises.text: Social group interaction, curated interest channels, discovery, and public/private/hidden privacy toggles for groups, events, and members
premises.evidence_span: We've also created something new called channels

premises.text: Most groups free; revenue from channel subscriptions, premium groups, and transaction service fees
premises.evidence_span: for the vast majority of groups, it's entirely free

value.text: One solution organizers need to engage membership and connect communities
value.evidence_span: it is the single solution that an organizer needs to engage their membership

secondary_value.text: Unify entrepreneurial ecosystems and export entrepreneurship globally via university communities
secondary_value.evidence_span: unify the entire entrepreneurial ecosystem and export entrepreneurship globally

notes: Five-platform organizer/member friction folded as one pain (§4.1.6).
